title: Holding More Than One Kestrel Auto Finance Contract
content:
A customer may hold several Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, one per financed purchase order. How many of them may be active at once, and how much principal they may carry together, is limited by the portfolio exposure limits: the maximum active contracts and the maximum aggregate exposure of the tier being approved.

## What the rule fixes

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Contracts per financed purchase order | one |
| Contracts per customer | several are allowed; this rule sets no fixed per-customer number of its own |
| Limit on active contracts and combined principal | the portfolio exposure limits (maximum active contracts, maximum aggregate exposure) |

## Basis Q&A

**Can one purchase order be financed by two Kestrel Auto Finance contracts?** No. Each contract finances one purchase order.

**Is there a separate cap on the number of contracts a customer can ever hold?** This rule sets none. The ceiling that applies is the portfolio exposure limit on active contracts and combined principal.

**Hypothetical:** a customer who financed two vehicles on two purchase orders holds two contracts, one for each order.
